# Native reference text: exact reviewed successor

The three `before` files are byte-for-byte copies of the reviewed V35B
notifications-preparation predecessor, checked against its adjacent initial
manifest before copying. The complete original manifest is stored losslessly
as `predecessor-manifest.json.gz`; the tests pin its uncompressed SHA-256.

`manifest.json` is the original native integration review package, not a new
inventory generated by these tests. Its hash and the exact three before/after
paths are pinned in `reviewed-reference-successor.ts`.

The historical composer inventories remain unchanged. The successor helper
admits only these exact files and hashes. It proves all 143 retained raw actions,
including every attribute and full ancestor chain, and exactly four reference
renderers in their old text positions. Two reviewed preview navigators become
plain-text component fallbacks; focused tests compare the real native fallback
destinations to the authenticated old navigator URLs, with and without scope.

No controller, cursor, read-acknowledgement, permission, platform control or
unrelated page receives an exception. This fixture does not authorize future
hash refreshes: any new source change requires its own reviewed transition.
